description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that can't be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Vhal.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Vhal.
Repeat.
